Inner regularity similarly guarantees that for any Baire set Eo, there exists a compact subset whose inner measure approximates v\(C). These properties are linked through the Baire contraction v of a Borel measure μ, where v(E) = μ(E) for all Baire sets E. The necessity and sufficiency of these conditions for regularity is established via duality between open and closed approximations. Failure modes arise when the space lacks local compactness or when μ is not Borel measurable.
